hero.title: Engineering Consulting & Solutions
hero.text: MS Square is a Sudanese company specialized in contracting, construction, and engineering consulting. We deliver your projects from full construction to finishing, rehabilitation, and maintenance, with the highest standards of quality and safety.

about.heading: Who We Are, Our Mission & Vision
about.aboutText: MS Square is a Sudanese company specialized in contracting, construction, and engineering consulting, providing integrated engineering and construction solutions for the public and private sectors — from consulting and engineering design, to full construction, finishing, rehabilitation, maintenance, and infrastructure support, in addition to supplying construction materials.
about.missionText: To deliver reliable construction and engineering solutions that meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency, while building long-term client relationships through professionalism, transparency, and consistent performance.
about.visionText: To become one of the leading contracting and engineering companies in Sudan and the region, by delivering sustainable projects, maintaining the highest execution standards, and earning client trust through excellence at every project stage.

items.title: Sally Soap Factory — Buildings & Finishing

assessmentReport.heading: Sample Assessment & Cost Model: Health Center Rehabilitation
assessmentReport.intro: An illustrative example of our methodology for assessing and pricing rehabilitation projects, grounded in real work MS Square has completed and current Sudan market rates.
assessmentReport.step1Text: Before any work begins, we conduct a full, comprehensive assessment of the building — inspecting all visible and potential damage, and confirming with certainty whether any structural issues exist before starting rehabilitation work.
assessmentReport.step1PriceNote: Depending on the size of the engineering team required

items.title: Electrical Works
items.text: Full inspection and renewal of electrical wiring, energy-efficient LED lighting throughout, ceiling and exhaust fans, air conditioning for reception, consultation rooms and the lab, and a new main distribution panel meeting safety standards.

items.title: Plumbing Works
items.text: Renewal of water supply and drainage lines, new sanitary fittings for the restroom and lab, and proper roof rainwater drainage.

items.title: Crack Treatment
items.text: Careful inspection of all visible surface cracks, treatment and reinforcement with approved materials, to definitively confirm there is no structural weakness in the building.

items.title: Painting & Finishing Coats
items.text: Full interior and exterior painting with moisture- and heat-resistant materials, applied after every weak point has been repaired — because paint doesn't fix concrete, it's the final stage after real repair.

items.title: General Finishes
items.text: Roof thermal insulation, new floor ceramic tiling, and maintenance or replacement of damaged doors, windows and glass, delivering a fully functional facility to a high quality standard.

addons.title: Basic Medical Equipment
addons.text: Examination beds, basic lab equipment, pharmacy medicine refrigerators, and medical furniture for reception and consultation rooms — optional, outside the core contracting scope.

addons.title: 15kW Solar Power System
addons.text: Solar panels, batteries and a 15kW inverter to cover essential loads and reduce grid dependency, ensuring uninterrupted medical service.

assessmentReport.totalLabel: Full Scenario — With All Optional Add-ons
assessmentReport.totalNote: Includes a 10% project management and contingency reserve. Final cost is confirmed after the structural assessment and site survey.
assessmentReport.sourceNote: Figures are based on MS Square's internal engineering studies and actual work completed in Khartoum during July 2026, in line with local market prices for the same period.
